latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of memory-m3e:

- Adds semantic memory plugin using m3e-large embedding API (1536 dimensions).
- Supports persistent storage with SQLite.
- Pure JavaScript cosine similarity search (no native dependencies).
- Automatic index refresh every 10 minutes.
- Provides three tools: memory_store, memory_recall, and memory_forget.
- Includes performance metrics and flexible configuration options.
